summary: This document explains how IPv4 and IPv6 coexistence combined with poor IPv6 support in VPN products can make traffic that should go through an encrypted tunnel leak out unprotected on the local network. It discusses the problem and mitigations.

eli5.summary: Imagine a secret tunnel that only covers one of two doors. Some of your messages can sneak out the other door in plain view. This RFC explains why that happens.

questions: why does my vpn leak ipv6 traffic
